content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Issue:** Section 7.6 (¶p0032) requires *Customer* to pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as "agreed liquidated damages" for any delay in providing a dependency — uncapped, undefined trigger, and potentially exceeding remaining contract value.
- **Direction check:** This runs against us, not in our favour. No service-credit or Vendor-payable LD regime was disturbed (Section 3 contains no credits to strike; Sections 9 and 21 contain no termination fee or penalty payable by us — Section 27 expressly lets us terminate "without penalty").
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** delete Section 7.6 in full, with the three-months'-fees early-termination fee offered as fallback in the comment consistent with prior approved language.
